Як переказати чуже питання і як ввічливо: How to report someone’s question and how to ask a stranger politely: asked if / whether ..., asked where she lived, Do you know where ...? Could you tell me what time ...? The main rule: an indirect question has normal word order and no do / does / did.
Переказуємо питання «так / ні»: asked if: Reporting a yes / no question: asked if / whether ...
Max asked if I was ready.
Переказуємо питання з питальним словом:: Reporting a question with a question word: asked where / what / why ...
Ввічливо питаємо незнайомих: Could you t: Asking strangers politely: Could you tell me ...?
Чи не могли б ви сказати, о котрій відкр: Could you tell me what time the shop opens?
Asking if someone knows: Do you know ...?
Ти не знаєш, де Іра?: Do you know where Ira is?
Кажемо, чого не знаємо або що нам цікаво: Saying what we don’t know or wonder about: I don’t know / I wonder ...
I wonder why the bus is late.
asked (me) + if / whether + підмет + діє: asked (me) + if / whether + subject + verb. In reported questions, if or whether means «whether».
asked (me) + where / what / when ... + п: asked (me) + where / what / when ... + subject + verb. The word order is like a normal sentence, not like a question.
Допоміжні do / does / did зникають, а ос: The helping verbs do / does / did disappear, and the main verb takes the right form itself.
Заперечення лишається, але порядок прями: The negative stays, but the order is direct: subject + wasn’t / didn’t + V.
Після asked час відступає на крок назад,: After asked the tense moves one step back, as in reported speech: is → was, do → did, did → had done, can → could, will → would.
Ввічливе питання: Do you know / Could yo: A polite question: Do you know / Could you tell me + question word or if + subject + verb. No backshift, because we are asking now.
У непрямому питанні підмет стоїть перед: In an indirect question the subject comes before the verb: where I lived. where did I live and where lived I are wrong here.
Питання «так / ні» без питального слова: A yes / no question without a question word is reported with if or whether. Without them the sentence falls apart.
In Do you know ...? and Could you tell me ...? the verb is goes after the subject, at the end. After I wonder / I don’t know we put a full stop, not a question mark.
Ліворуч пряме питання, посередині перека: On the left the direct question, in the middle the report after asked (with backshift), on the right a polite question now (no backshift). If who or what is itself the subject, the order doesn’t change: “Who called?” → She asked who had called.
